$comment: English text of the rules' messages and the countermeasures (the files next to this folder are in Spanish, the default). Same ids; only wording differs. Loaded when a request asks for lang=en.

rules.arm-asymmetry: One arm is moving differently from the other (asymmetry {value}, limit {threshold}).
rules.perclos-high: Eyes closed {value} of the time, above {threshold}.
rules.fatigue-score-high: Fatigue score {value}, at or above {threshold}: not safe to stay awake on task.
rules.sleep-under-6h: Slept {value} {unit} in the last 24 h, under {threshold} {unit}: in astronauts this went with slower reactions.
rules.mood-low: Mood {value} out of 5, at or below {threshold}.
rules.radiation-dose-high: Simulated radiation dose {value} {unit}, at or above {threshold} {unit}.

CM-MOTOR-01.title: One arm moving differently
steps: Stop the current task and make it safe.
Hold still in a secure position.
Raise both arms in front of you and hold them there for a few seconds.
Tell a crew member what you notice and stay with them.
Ask the crew to contact the flight surgeon.
If you were holding something or were out of the camera view, say so: the reading may be wrong.

CM-DROWSY-01.title: Eyes closing often
steps: Pause any task that needs fast reactions or fine control.
Tell a crew member you are drowsy.
Ask the crew to double-check critical steps before you continue.
Take a rest break when the schedule allows.

CM-FATIGUE-01.title: Short sleep or slow reactions
steps: Avoid starting tasks that need fast reactions if they can wait.
Tell a crew member before you continue critical work.
Ask the crew to double-check critical steps.
Plan a sleep period as soon as the schedule allows.
Repeat the reaction test after resting.

CM-MOOD-01.title: Low mood
steps: Take a few minutes away from the current task.
Talk to a crew member you trust.
Ask the crew to schedule a private call with the support team on the ground.

CM-CO2-01.title: High cabin CO2
steps: Check the cabin CO2 reading on the vehicle display.
Report the reading to the crew.
Follow the vehicle's CO2 procedure.
Tell the crew if you feel unwell.

CM-EXHAUSTED-01.title: Too exhausted to stay on task
steps: Stop what you are doing and make it safe.
Tell the crew you need to sleep now and hand over any critical task.
Go to your sleep station and rest.

CM-RAD-01.title: Raised radiation dose
steps: Report the dose reading to the crew.
Follow the crew's radiation procedure, for example moving to the shielded area if instructed.
Keep your dosimeter on.
Note the time and the dose so the flight surgeon can add it to your exposure record.
Stay in the shielded area until the crew confirms the reading has dropped.
